# Sanitized genuine V5 baseline

This archive is generated before M7 product changes by the accepted C2B schema5 built HTTP handlers and real business services. It contains a real fixed claim/review snapshot, two distinct reviewer identities/groups and post-request sessions, two complete revealed opinions, one accepted immutable decision and an unacknowledged thread consumer batch. No formal states are fabricated with SQL and no artifact rows or blob store are created.

`database.sqlite` has all credentials and instance token_secret removed, checkpointed and VACUUMed into a new archive. Actor/session/material/formal/event/idempotency/consumer references remain exact. The secret-free archive deliberately fails initialized-runtime classification and cannot be served directly. Manifest records actual source/runtime/schema and row/archive hashes, public fixed refs, sanitization and pending history. Generated secret/token/hash values never enter the manifest or logs.

Normal tests verify archive/manifest hashes and copy the archive to a new private temporary directory. Before coordinator/maintenance open, use raw SQLite to insert a fresh random token_secret into the COPY, preserving initialized=true and historical rows; record the hydrated source hash separately. For authenticated reads/replay only, add fresh bounded temporary credentials to the same retained actors. No original mutation, bootstrap/init, new reviewer/session or formal-state synthesis is hydration. Generator, old Git/temp/runtime credentials and model accounts are not normal test inputs.

`generate-v5.mjs` is an explicit pre-M7 capture recipe bound to the fresh accepted393 source/535 built inventory. It refuses an existing archive/manifest. Run only when root authorizes V5 capture and the accepted built remains unchanged; no build/install is done. From the repository root: `node tests/fixtures/m7-schema5-baseline/generate-v5.mjs`. Generation uses app.inject (actual handler/service, not TCP proof), one owned short-lived directory, then removes that directory. Alternate explicit output directory must already exist. Sourceproof and command/cleanup evidence belong to M7 verification/capture. Random IDs/bootstrap/time mean semantic reproducibility rather than byte-identical regeneration.
